protocol.scope: Six frozen policy/representation matrices; Gaussian mixture assignments are never refitted or supplied to UMAP. Three seeds are a sensitivity grid, not uncertainty intervals.

mds.protocol: Metric equal-weight SMACOF on the same frozen scores as the UMAP audit; three starts, seed 42, maximum 1000 iterations, tolerance 0.000001. All pair distances included. No cluster refit.

fits.algorithm: Metric SMACOF, equal weight for every unordered pair including zero distances
fits.initialization: Seeded uniform random coordinates, centered and scaled to target RMS pair distance
fits.selection: Smallest finite final raw stress across starts; iteration-limited selection is disclosed
fits.convergence_rule: Stress decrease divided by current sum of squared embedding distances below tolerance
fits.role: Display only; Euclidean distances in all retained, unwhitened scores; no cluster labels supplied
